name: has_phd
description: Founder holds a PhD or doctorate
expression: lambda founder: any('phd' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'doctor' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: prior_ipo
description: Founder has been involved in a prior IPO

name: industry_tech
description: Founder is in the technology or internet industry
expression: lambda founder: 'technology' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'internet' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: industry_health
description: Founder is in healthcare or medical industry
expression: lambda founder: 'health' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'medical' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: education_high_qs
description: Founder has an education from a QS top-ranked institution (QS rank 10 or better)
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_executive_role
description: Founder has held an executive role (e.g., CEO, President, Director)
expression: lambda founder: any('ceo' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'president' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'director' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_focused
description: Founder has experience predominantly in a specific industry (e.g., industry name appears more than once)
expression: lambda founder: sum(1 for job in founder.get('jobs', []) if founder.get('industry', '').lower() in job.get('industry', '').lower()) > 1

name: has_education
description: Founder has at least one education record

name: industry_investment
description: Founder is involved in finance or investment related industries
expression: lambda founder: 'finance' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'investment' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'venture' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'private equity' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: industry_startup
description: Founder's industry is explicitly linked to startup activity
expression: lambda founder: 'startup' in founder.get('anonymised_prose', '').lower() or 'lead' in founder.get('anonymised_prose', '').lower()

name: has_education_from_top_qs
description: Founder has at least one QS top-10 institution education
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: experience_in_management
description: Founder has held management roles such as VP, COO, or similar
expression: lambda founder: any('vp' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'coo' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'manager' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_extractive
description: Founder is in extractive industries such as mining, oil, gas
expression: lambda founder: 'extractive' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'oil' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'gas' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'mining' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_high_qs_ranking
description: Founder’s education QS ranking is better than 50
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) < 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: industry_investment_related
description: Founder’s industry relates to investment, private equity, or venture capital
expression: lambda founder: 'venture' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'private equity' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'investment' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()

name: has_executive_experience
description: Founder has held an executive position
expression: lambda founder: any('ceo' in job.get('role', '').lower() or 'president' in job.get('role', '').lower() for job in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_innovation
description: Founder’s industry is linked to innovative sectors like biotech or nanotech
expression: lambda founder: 'biotech' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'nanotech' in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or 'biotechnology' in founder.get('industry', '').lower()
